Tonight, he thought, he would finally send something back across the water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯把空旷的马路照得发白，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，留下湿漉漉的轮印。便利店的灯依旧亮着，店员靠在柜台后打着哈欠。早起的环卫工推着车，扫帚划过地面发出沙沙的声响。远处的高楼只亮着零星几盏窗，像没睡着的眼睛。空气里带着凉意，天边隐约泛起一线微光，新的一天正悄悄酝酿。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It keeps shrinking the problem until it reaches a tiny step so easy it needs no more shrinking.\n- Like looking up a word in a dictionary whose meaning sends you to another word, until you finally reach one you already know."}
